title: Traffic analysis with Wireshark and tcpdump

videos.script: Logs say that something happened. Flow records say how much. A packet capture says exactly what was said. {{levels}} This lesson records one ordinary download in your lab, and then takes it apart. {{capture}} First with tcpdump, packet by packet. Then with tshark, the command line half of Wireshark: the conversation, the request, the reply. {{tshark}} And then the file itself, rebuilt from the packets, with a hash to prove it is the same file. {{export}} Last, the limit: what encryption hides, and what it never does.
